name: Sheet pan squash soup
source: Love & Lemons (Jeanine Donofrio), adapted, Sheet Pan Squash Soup
why: The original leans on a roasted onion and five cloves of garlic for sweetness and depth. Roasted fennel and carrot give you the sweetness; white miso covers the savory depth on its own.
steps: Halve the squash lengthwise and scrape the seeds out. Quarter the fennel bulb and halve the carrots.
Everything cut-side down on a parchment-lined sheet pan, drizzled with a tablespoon of oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 400°F for 40–50 minutes, until the squash gives easily and the fennel edges have browned.
Scoop the squash flesh into a blender with the roasted fennel and carrot, broth, miso, vinegar, and the remaining oil. Blend about a minute until fully creamy.
Season aggressively — squash soup takes more salt than you expect. Thin with broth if it's too thick.
Cool uncovered before it goes in a container, or the steam waters it down.
